claimBoundary: This receipt binds the C1-C8 route matrix and multi-round lineage closure rules only. It is not route execution evidence, not chain saturation, not universal Word/Google parity, not byte identity, and not product import/apply authority.
multiRoundLineageRequirements: Every route contour must use the full canonical synthetic book denominator, never excerpt/smoke evidence for final PASS.
Every hop must bind exact Yalken SHA, provider build/profile, document id, round id, effect/apply id, source revision, target revision, and provider revision when available.
Every route must compare before/after semantic text, structure, comments, suggestions, formatting, recovery, and cleanup through independent oracles.
C3 and every repeated route must use fresh round/effect/apply ids and must prove replay, cross-round transplant, stale revision, and idempotency negatives cannot mutate.
Provider conversion loss must be typed as MANUAL, BLOCKED, or LOSS with no silent omission and no promotion to universal parity.
FALSE_AUTO_APPLY_COUNT must remain 0 for any route-level PASS.
UNKNOWN, ABSTAIN, or CONFLICTING can never aggregate to PASS.
No route may inherit Word evidence into Google, Google evidence into Word, or local synthetic evidence into real provider claims.
